# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with prominent blue eyes and a round face. He has been described as neat and snug, particularly after his wife's return. He is prone to flushing purple with rage when angry.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Outspoken, fussy, and fidgety, Mr. Harrison has a reputation for being a crank who is very plain-spoken and hard to please. He often smokes his pipe on his veranda and can be cantankerous, though he is also kind, sociable, and sympathetic. He initially harbors a strong prejudice against marriage and takes pride in expressing blunt truths.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c6 P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 c9 P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 c17 P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v3 c12 P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039)_

## History

Originally from Scottsford, New Brunswick, Mr. J. A. Harrison lived with his sister until her death, at which point he married Emily Scott to fulfill a deathbed promise. Following constant bickering over housekeeping habits and his profane parrot, Ginger, he separated from his wife and moved to Avonlea, buying the farm of Robert Bell. In Avonlea, he lived as a bachelor, hired John Henry Carter, and gained a local reputation as an outspoken crank. He initially clashed with Anne Shirley over a Jersey cow incident, but the two quickly became close friends and confidants, with Mr. Harrison offering her blunt feedback on her writing. After Ginger died, his wife Emily arrived in Avonlea and reconciled with him, after which he became a neat, regular churchgoer.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008), [v3 c11 P50](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0050), [v3 c12 P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039)_
